audit_status.source_base: Greek Acts text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for temple healing at Beautiful Gate, name of Jesus Messiah, walking/leaping/praising, Peter's Solomon Portico speech, Author of life, turning and restoration times.

verses.restored: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth.

familiar.text: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.

verses.restored: A certain man, lame from his mother's womb, was being carried, whom they placed day by day at the gate of the temple called Beautiful, to ask alms from those entering the temple.

familiar.text: And a certain man lame from his mother’s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

verses.restored: Seeing Peter and John about to enter the temple, he was asking to receive alms.

familiar.text: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.

verses.restored: Peter, fixing his gaze on him with John, said, Look at us.

familiar.text: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.

verses.restored: He held attention on them, expecting to receive something from them.

familiar.text: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.

verses.restored: Peter said, Silver and gold do not belong to me; but what I have, this I give to you: in the name of Jesus Messiah the Nazarene, walk.

familiar.text: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

verses.restored: Taking him by the right hand, he raised him; immediately his feet and ankles were strengthened.

familiar.text: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.

verses.restored: Leaping up, he stood and began walking, and entered with them into the temple, walking and leaping and praising the Divine.

familiar.text: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

verses.restored: All the people saw him walking and praising the Divine.

familiar.text: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

verses.restored: They recognized him as the one sitting for alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple, and they were filled with wonder and astonishment at what had happened to him.

familiar.text: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.

verses.restored: While he held Peter and John, all the people ran together to them at the portico called Solomon's, utterly amazed.

familiar.text: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

verses.restored: Seeing this, Peter answered the people, Men of Israel, why do you marvel at this, or why do you stare at us, as if by our own power or reverence we made him walk?

familiar.text: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

verses.restored: The Divine of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the Divine of our fathers, glorified his servant/child Jesus, whom you handed over and denied before Pilate, though that one had judged to release him.

familiar.text: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

verses.restored: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a man who was a murderer be granted to you.

familiar.text: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;

verses.restored: You killed the Author/Leader of life, whom the Divine raised from the dead; of this we are witnesses.

familiar.text: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

verses.restored: And by trust in his name, his name strengthened this one whom you behold and know; the trust through him gave this complete wholeness before all of you.

familiar.text: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

verses.restored: Now, siblings, I know that you acted in ignorance, just as also your rulers did.

familiar.text: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.

verses.restored: But what the Divine announced beforehand through the mouth of all the prophets, that his Messiah would suffer, he fulfilled in this way.

familiar.text: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.

verses.restored: Turn/realign therefore and return, for your sins/misalignments to be wiped away, so that seasons of refreshing may come from the face of the Lord,

familiar.text: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

verses.restored: and that he may send the one appointed for you, Messiah Jesus,

familiar.text: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:

verses.restored: whom heaven must receive until times of restoration of all things, of which the Divine spoke through the mouth of his holy prophets from the age.

familiar.text: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

verses.restored: Moses indeed said, The Lord your Divine will raise up for you a prophet like me from your siblings; you shall hear him according to all things whatever he speaks to you.

familiar.text: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.

verses.restored: It will be that every soul/life that does not hear that prophet will be utterly removed from the people.

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

verses.restored: And all the prophets from Samuel and those after him, as many as spoke, also announced these days.

familiar.text: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.

verses.restored: You are sons/children of the prophets and of the covenant that the Divine made with your fathers, saying to Abraham, In your seed all the families of the earth will be blessed.

familiar.text: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

verses.restored: To you first, the Divine, having raised up his servant/child, sent him blessing you by turning each of you away from your harmful ways.

familiar.text: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
